# Instructions
#### Launch Visual Studio Code Chat, connect to your Dynatrace tenant using dtctl and enter the following prompt:

# Use Case 1
#### Report on all dashboard tiles.

#### I created a workflow (https://github.com/TechShady/WorkFlows/blob/main/workflowexample1.workflow.json) by getting DQL from every tile that has DQL in a dashboard (https://github.com/TechShady/WorkFlows/blob/main/DashboardExample.json) and adding a workflow step to my workflow for each DQL query. The workflow runs each DQL concurrently, then passes the results to Dynatrace Intelligence for analysis. Each Dynatrace Intelligence task sends the results to another Dynatrace Intelligence task (overall_prompt) to summarize the results. It will also send a summary exec email (overall_prompt) and another detail summary email (overall_prompt and dql prompts). I need you to create the same type of workflow from a Dashboard at "[your directory or repo for your dashboard]". Make sure to build a DQL workflow step for each DQL based tile and add a timeframe filter for yesterday. Do not include queries that start with data record. If the query does not start with data json:"[]", use "from: @d-1d, to: @d" for the timeframe filter. If the DQL is fetching from user events, make sure to use user.events and not user_events. If the Dashboard has any filters using variables (the field will start with a $), please remove those filters. If the DQL query doesn't have a limit, use limit 25. Other than the above conditions, do not alter the DQL in any other way and make sure each DQL tile in the dashboard is added to a DQL task in the workflow. Do not skip any Dashboard tiles and make sure each Workflow task connects to Dynatrace Intelligence task. The examples have 8 Dashboard tiles, 8 DQL tasks and 9 Dynatrace Intelligence tasks and two email tasks, but Dashboards that use this prompt will have many tiles, so make sure to create the tasks (DQL tasks and Dynatrace Intelligence tasks) for each Dashboard tile. Add [your email address] to the to address in the send email steps. When done, upload the workflow into the tenant.

# Use Case 2
#### Report on only dashboard tiles that need attention.

#### I created a workflow (https://github.com/TechShady/WorkFlows/blob/main/workflowexample2.workflow.json) by getting DQL from every tile that has DQL in a dashboard (https://github.com/TechShady/WorkFlows/blob/main/DashboardExample.json) and adding a two workflow steps to my workflow for each DQL query. The workflow runs each DQL concurrently, then passes the results to Dynatrace Intelligence for analysis. Each Dynatrace Intelligence task (two per DQL) sends the results to another Dynatrace Intelligence task (overall_prompt) to summarize the results. It will also send a summary exec email (overall_prompt) and another detail summary email (overall_prompt and dql prompts). I need you to create the same type of workflow from a Dashboard at "[your directory or repo for your dashboard]". Make sure to build a DQL workflow step for each DQL based tile and add a timeframe filter for yesterday. Do not include queries that start with data record. If the query does not start with data json:"[]", use "from: @d-1d, to: @d" for the timeframe filter. If the DQL is fetching from user events, make sure to use user.events and not user_events. If the Dashboard has any filters using variables (the field will start with a $), please remove those filters. If the DQL query doesn't have a limit, use limit 25. Other than the above conditions, do not alter the DQL in any other way and make sure each DQL tile in the dashboard is added to a DQL task in the workflow. Do not skip any Dashboard tiles and make sure each Workflow task connects to Dynatrace Intelligence task. The examples have 8 Dashboard tiles, 8 DQL tasks and 17 Dynatrace Intelligence tasks and two email tasks, but Dashboards that use this prompt will have many tiles, so make sure to create the tasks (DQL tasks and Dynatrace Intelligence tasks) for each Dashboard tile. Add [your email address] to the to address in the send email steps. When done, upload the workflow into the tenant.
